Indonesian Presidential Candidate Claims Indian Heritage

Indonesian presidential candidate Prabowo Subianto has stated he possesses 'Indian DNA' and emphasized India's influence on his country. He has reportedly made these statements multiple times, suggesting a historical or cultural connection. This highlights the cultural ties and historical interactions between India and Indonesia.
